notices.title: No work permit needed
notices.body: Citizens of the EU, of Iceland, Liechtenstein and Norway, and of Switzerland, can live and work in Germany, France, Spain and the Netherlands under free movement — the routes on this site are for other passports. Check registration rules after arrival (e.g. Anmeldung in Germany).

source.legal_basis: TFEU art. 45 (free movement of workers) — Your Europe

notices.title: Türkiye: extra rights once you are legally employed
notices.body: Your route options are the same as for any other non-EU passport: the EU–Türkiye agreement adds rights once you are legally working, rather than a separate way in. Where an authority states that its own requirements differ for Turkish citizens, that route's card says so — the Dutch orientation year is one.

source.quote: As a national of Türkiye, your rights to live and work in an EU country depend entirely on the national rules of that country. When employed legally in the EU, you enjoy the same working conditions as the nationals of that country and you have the following rights: after one year's legal employment you are entitled to a renewal of your work permit for the same employer if a job is available after three years' legal employment you may change employers and respond to any other employment offer within the same professional qualifications after four years' legal employment you enjoy full access to any paid employment in that EU country.
source.legal_basis: EEC–Turkey Association Agreement, Decision 1/80 art. 6 — Your Europe

notices.title: Algeria: a separate agreement, and a question no page we found answers
notices.body: France does not apply the residence-permit provisions of its own immigration code to Algerian nationals: the Franco-Algerian agreement of 27 December 1968 governs instead. The Conseil d'État said so on 2 March 2026, in a case about a trader's residence certificate rather than a talent card, so its words settle the principle and not the talent cards themselves. The page the administration routes an Algerian reader to is a one-year certificat de résidence; for a salaried job in France it says the certificate will carry the mention salarié, and none of the situations it lists is a passeport talent or an EU Blue Card — read to the end on 2026-09-10. Against that stands the EU directive behind the Blue Card, whose scope article covers third-country nationals admitted for highly qualified employment. We searched service-public, france-visas, the ministry and the ANEF portal on 2026-09-10 for a page saying whether an Algerian national may hold a passeport talent, and found none. So the four talent routes on this site are scored exactly as they are for any other non-EU passport: that is us declining to guess, not an answer.

source.quote: Il suit de là que les dispositions du code de l'entrée et du séjour des étrangers et du droit d'asile qui sont relatives aux différents titres de séjour qui peuvent être délivrés aux étrangers en général et aux conditions de leur délivrance, ne sont pas applicables aux ressortissants algériens, lesquels relèvent à cet égard des règles fixées par l'accord précité.

sources.quote: This Directive applies to third-country nationals who apply to be admitted, or who have been admitted, to the territory of a Member State for the purpose of highly qualified employment under this Directive.

routes.name: Self-employment and freelance work (§ 21)
routes.summary: One section of the Residence Act holding two routes: a residence permit for running a business, and an easier one for the liberal professions — doctor, interpreter, artist, writer, architect.

scope.reason: This route is not scored, and nothing below asks you anything. The permit is granted on an assessment of your business plan — how sound the idea is, what you have run before, how much capital you are putting in, what it does for jobs and training, and what it adds to innovation and research — weighed together with the local chambers, the trade authorities and the professional bodies. Five judgements and a committee are not something a form can reach, so we state what the statute says, in its own words, with the day we read it.

statements.text: A permit for self-employment may be granted where there is an economic interest or a regional need, where the activity is expected to have positive effects on the economy, and where the financing is secured by your own capital or by a credit commitment.

source.quote: Einem Ausländer kann eine Aufenthaltserlaubnis zur Ausübung einer selbständigen Tätigkeit erteilt werden, wenn 1. ein wirtschaftliches Interesse oder ein regionales Bedürfnis besteht, 2. die Tätigkeit positive Auswirkungen auf die Wirtschaft erwarten lässt und 3. die Finanzierung der Umsetzung durch Eigenkapital oder durch eine Kreditzusage gesichert ist.

statements.text: Whether those conditions are met is assessed on the viability of the business idea behind them, your entrepreneurial experience, the amount of capital committed, the effect on employment and training, and the contribution to innovation and research.

source.quote: Die Beurteilung der Voraussetzungen nach Satz 1 richtet sich insbesondere nach der Tragfähigkeit der zu Grunde liegenden Geschäftsidee, den unternehmerischen Erfahrungen des Ausländers, der Höhe des Kapitaleinsatzes, den Auswirkungen auf die Beschäftigungs- und Ausbildungssituation und dem Beitrag für Innovation und Forschung.

statements.text: The bodies with expertise where you plan to work take part in the decision: the chambers, the trade authorities, the public-law professional associations and the authorities that license the profession.

source.quote: Bei der Prüfung sind die für den Ort der geplanten Tätigkeit fachkundigen Körperschaften, die zuständigen Gewerbebehörden, die öffentlich-rechtlichen Berufsvertretungen und die für die Berufszulassung zuständigen Behörden zu beteiligen.

statements.text: What is examined, and what it is examined from: a business plan, submitted with the application, showing the idea, the experience, the capital, the regional effect on jobs and training, and the contribution to innovation and research.

source.quote: The following criteria in particular will be examined by reference to an informative and meaningful business plan, which you must submit when applying for the residence title: the sustainability of your business idea, your business experience, the amount of capital which you propose to invest, the regional impact with regard to employment and training, and the contribution which your enterprise can make to innovation and research.

routes.name: Employee, general regime (residencia y trabajo por cuenta ajena)
routes.summary: The general regime's way in: an employer in Spain applies for a non-EU worker to live and work as an employee. The authorisation lasts as long as the job, up to a year, and is tied to one occupation and one autonomous community.

scope.reason: This route is not scored, and nothing below asks you anything. Whether it opens at all depends on the national employment situation, which has two doors: your occupation is on a catalogue of hard-to-fill jobs that the public employment service redraws every three months for each autonomous community, or your employer has to satisfy the immigration office that the post could not be filled from the labour market already here. A quarterly regional list and an office's judgement of somebody else's recruiting are not facts you could declare, so we quote the regulation and date it instead.

statements.text: The national employment situation must permit hiring you, on the terms article 75 sets out.

source.quote: Que la situación nacional de empleo permita la contratación de la persona trabajadora extranjera en los términos previstos en el artículo 75 o, en el caso de que la autorización se encuadre en un procedimiento de gestión colectiva de contrataciones en origen, en los términos que se establezca en la orden correspondiente.

statements.text: One way through is the catalogue of hard-to-fill occupations, drawn up every three months by the state employment service for each autonomous community and for Ceuta and Melilla.

source.quote: A los efectos de determinar la situación nacional de empleo, el Servicio Público de Empleo Estatal elaborará, con periodicidad trimestral, de acuerdo con la información suministrada por los servicios públicos de empleo autonómicos y previa consulta de la Comisión Laboral Tripartita de Inmigración, un catálogo de ocupaciones de difícil cobertura para cada Comunidad Autónoma, así como para las ciudades de Ceuta y Melilla.

statements.text: For an occupation not on that catalogue, your employer must show the immigration office that the vacancy could not be filled from workers already in the internal labour market, and the office weighs the employment service's report and how urgent the hire is.

source.quote: Asimismo, se considerará que la situación nacional de empleo permite la contratación en las ocupaciones no calificadas como de difícil cobertura cuando el empleador acredite ante la Oficina de Extranjería la dificultad de cubrir los puestos de trabajo vacantes con trabajadores ya incorporados en el mercado laboral interno. A estos efectos, la oficina de extranjería tendrá en consideración el informe presentado por los Servicios Públicos de Empleo, así como la urgencia de la contratación acreditada por la empresa.

statements.text: A contract signed by you and by your employer, guaranteeing continuous work for as long as the authorisation runs, whose start date must be conditioned on the authorisation taking effect.

source.quote: Que el empleador presente un contrato de trabajo firmado por la persona trabajadora y por él mismo y que se establezca para la persona trabajadora una actividad continuada durante el periodo de vigencia de la autorización inicial de residencia temporal y trabajo por cuenta ajena. La fecha de comienzo del contrato deberá estar condicionada al momento de eficacia de la autorización de residencia temporal y trabajo por cuenta ajena.

statements.text: For part-time work, the total pay over the year must reach the full-time minimum wage.

source.quote: En el caso de que la contratación fuera a tiempo parcial, la retribución total a percibir por la persona solicitante deberá ser igual o superior al salario mínimo interprofesional para jornada completa y en cómputo anual.

statements.text: Where your employer is a person rather than a company, they must also show they can support their own household, on top of your salary: monthly means of 50% of the Spanish minimum wage if nobody depends on them, 100% for a two-person household, and 25% more of it for every further member.

source.quote: Cuando el empleador requerido sea una persona física, deberá además acreditar que cuenta con medios económicos suficientes para atender sus necesidades y las de su familia. statements.text: You must have the training and, where the profession requires one, the professional qualification the law demands for practising it.

source.quote: Que la persona trabajadora tenga la capacitación y, en su caso, la cualificación profesional legalmente exigida para el ejercicio de la profesión.

statements.text: The first authorisation lasts as long as the work does, up to a year, and is limited to one autonomous community and one occupation.

source.quote: La autorización inicial de residencia temporal y trabajo por cuenta ajena tendrá una duración igual a la de la actividad a desarrollar, con el máximo de un año, y se limitará, en lo relativo al ejercicio de la actividad laboral y salvo en los casos previstos por la Ley y los Convenios Internacionales firmados por España, a un ámbito geográfico autonómico y a una ocupación determinada.

routes.name: International teleworker (teletrabajo de carácter internacional)
routes.summary: Living in Spain while working remotely, by computer and telecommunications only, for employers or clients based outside it. A visa from abroad lasts up to a year; a residence authorisation applied for inside Spain lasts up to three.

scope.reason: This route is not scored, and nothing below asks you anything. It turns on a situation this interview never asks about — that you already work remotely for a company trading outside Spain, and have done for at least three months — and on an income floor the law states only as sufficient means for you and your family. The binding figure is not in the law: it is set as a multiple of a minimum wage a separate decree resets each year, in an instruction no fetch of ours can reach. We will not do arithmetic on your behalf and call it a rule, so the rules are quoted here and dated.

statements.text: Work done remotely for companies based outside Spain, by computer, telematic and telecommunications means only.

source.quote: Se halla en situación de residencia por teletrabajo de carácter internacional el nacional de un tercer Estado, autorizado a permanecer en España para ejercer una actividad laboral o profesional a distancia para empresas radicadas fuera del territorio nacional, mediante el uso exclusivo de medios y sistemas informáticos, telemáticos y de telecomunicación.

statements.text: Working for yourself rather than for an employer, you may take work from a company based in Spain, as long as it is no more than a fifth of what you do.

source.quote: En el supuesto de ejercicio de una actividad profesional, se permitirá al titular de la autorización por teletrabajo de carácter internacional trabajar para una empresa ubicada en España, siempre y cuando el porcentaje de dicho trabajo no sea superior al 20 % del total de su actividad profesional.

statements.text: From outside Spain you apply for a teleworking visa, valid for up to a year. Applied for inside Spain, the residence authorisation runs for up to three years.

source.quote: Los extranjeros no residentes en España, que se propongan residir en territorio español con el fin de teletrabajar a distancia para una empresa no ubicada en España, solicitarán el visado para teletrabajo de carácter internacional que tendrá una vigencia máxima de un año, salvo que el período de trabajo sea inferior, en cuyo caso el visado tendrá la misma vigencia que este.

routes.name: Single permit for paid employment (GVVA)
routes.summary: One permit combining residence and work, for ordinary paid employment in the Netherlands lasting more than 90 days. The employer normally applies, and the immigration service asks the employee insurance agency whether the work-permit conditions are met.

scope.reason: This route is not scored, and nothing below asks you anything. The statute makes the permit refusable if there is priority supply on the Dutch labour market for the job, if the vacancy was not reported to the employee insurance agency at least five weeks before the application, or if your employer cannot show enough effort to fill it from that supply — and the agency decides for itself whether the work could have been done from the EU or the wider European Economic Area. Those are facts about your employer's search and somebody else's reading of it, so we quote them, date them, and offer you no verdict.

statements.text: The permit must be refused where there is priority supply on the labour market for the job, where the vacancy was not reported to the employee insurance agency at least five weeks before the application, or where your employer cannot show sufficient effort to fill it from that supply.
